title: "PART 2 - Synthetic Data Assessment (daily Corsano data)"
author: "Piers Seidman"
date: "2026-11-11"
output: html_document
---

Generates one synthetic version of the daily Corsano data with the PART 1 generator, then assesses it.
Each section asks one question about the synthetic data, in this order:

1. Real data
2. Generate synthetic data
3. Days and missing values: are the wear pattern and the gaps the same?
4. Patient traits: same mix of response class / sex / age / BMI, without copying real patients?
5. Distributions: does each variable look the same on its own?
6. Correlations: do the wearable variables move together the same way?
7. Trajectories: same change over time?
8. Within-patient structure: same patient-to-patient spread, slopes and day-to-day correlation?
9. Model transfer: do the PART 4 models (`Model4WearablesV2_DailyMeans()`) give the same answer?
10. Overall utility and privacy
11. Summary


```{r libraries, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

py_require(python_version = "3.12")   # must run before keras3 on Windows

# Generator (PART 1)
library(keras3)        # Temporal VAE
library(tidyverse)     # dplyr, tidyr, purrr, ggplot2 (the generator needs all of them)
library(car)           # Box-Cox
library(lme4)          # noise structure inside the generator

# Models (PART 4 function)
library(nlme)          # Linear mixed-effects models
library(splines)       # Natural cubic splines ns()
library(emmeans)       # Marginal means & contrasts
library(weights)       # starmaker() inside the PART 4 function
library(performance)   # check_model() inside the PART 4 function
library(openxlsx)      # Excel output inside the PART 4 function

# Utility
library(synthpop)      # synthetic traits (generator) + utility.gen() S_pMSE

# Visualization
library(patchwork)     # Combine plots
```

```{r load generator}
# Load the generator functions from PART 1 (the 3 generator chunks)
rmd <- readLines(part1_file)

# pull the code of one chunk by its label
chunk_code <- function(label) {
  start <- grep(paste0("^```\\{r ", label), rmd)   # line where the chunk opens
  end   <- grep("^```\\s*$", rmd)                  # all lines that close a chunk
  end   <- end[end > start][1]                     # first close after the open
  rmd[(start + 1):(end - 1)]                       # code between them
}

# run the 3 generator chunks
walk(c("generator-main", "generator-model", "generator-helpers"),
     ~ eval(parse(text = chunk_code(.x)), envir = globalenv()))
```


```{r load PART 4 function}
# Load Model4WearablesV2_DailyMeans() from the PART 4 Rmd ("Updated Function" chunk), unchanged
part4    <- readLines(part4_rmd)
fn_start <- grep("^```\\{r Updated Function", part4)   # line where the chunk opens
fn_end   <- grep("^```\\s*$", part4)                   # all lines that close a chunk
fn_end   <- fn_end[fn_end > fn_start][1]               # first close after the open
eval(parse(text = part4[(fn_start + 1):(fn_end - 1)]))
```


## 1. Real data

```{r load data}
load(data_file)

corsano_real <- Daily_Corsano_DB_ADJ_Response %>%
  select(participant_id, Days_since_bio, all_of(key_vars), all_of(covs), resp_class_final)

cat("Real data:", n_distinct(corsano_real$participant_id), "patients,", nrow(corsano_real), "patient-days\n")
```


## 2. Generate synthetic data

Generated once and saved; later knits read the saved file. Delete the file (or change `seed_to_assess`) to generate
again.
**DATA CHANGES (generator input only):** `participant_id` is passed as `patient_id`; `sex_birth` and `on_any_steroid`
are passed as factors (categorical). Both are converted back after generating.

```{r generate}
# ---- Real data in the form the generator expects ----
for_generator <- corsano_real %>%
  rename(patient_id = participant_id) %>%           # generator needs patient_id
  mutate(sex_birth = factor(sex_birth),              # categorical
         on_any_steroid = factor(on_any_steroid))    # categorical

# ---- Generate ----
corsano_syn <- generate_synthetic_temporal_vae(for_generator,
                                               seed = seed_to_assess,
                                               verbose = 0,
                                               time_var = "Days_since_bio")

# ---- Back to original names / types ----
corsano_syn <- corsano_syn %>%
  rename(participant_id = patient_id) %>%
  mutate(participant_id = as.character(participant_id),
         sex_birth = as.character(sex_birth),
         on_any_steroid = as.numeric(as.character(on_any_steroid)))

saveRDS(corsano_syn, syn_file)   # save synthetic data

cat("Synthetic data (seed", seed_to_assess, "):", n_distinct(corsano_syn$participant_id), "patients,",
    nrow(corsano_syn), "patient-days\n")

# real and synthetic stacked, used by most sections below
both <- bind_rows(Real = corsano_real %>% mutate(participant_id = as.character(participant_id)),
                  Synthetic = corsano_syn,
                  .id = "source")
```

## 4. Patient traits

Traits are made by synthpop in the generator, so a synthetic patient should not be a copy of a real one.

```{r traits}
# one row per patient
real_traits <- both %>% filter(source == "Real")      %>% distinct(participant_id, across(all_of(traits)))
syn_traits  <- both %>% filter(source == "Synthetic") %>% distinct(participant_id, across(all_of(traits)))
both_traits <- bind_rows(Real = real_traits, Synthetic = syn_traits, .id = "source")
```

```{r trait mix}
# % of patients in each response class x sex group
trait_mix <- both_traits %>%
  count(source, resp_class_final, sex_birth) %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = pct)
print(trait_mix)

# age and BMI distribution
age_bmi_summary <- both_traits %>%
  pivot_longer(c(age_at_enrollment, bmi), names_to = "variable") %>%
  group_by(variable, source) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
print(age_bmi_summary)
```



```{r trait copies}
# ---- Exact copies of a real patient's traits ----
trait_key   <- function(d) paste(d$resp_class_final, d$sex_birth, d$age_at_enrollment, d$bmi)
exact_match <- mean(trait_key(syn_traits) %in% trait_key(real_traits))

# ---- Age and BMI gap to the nearest real patient with the same class and sex ----
nearest_gap <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(syn_traits)), function(i) {
  same <- real_traits %>%
    filter(resp_class_final == syn_traits$resp_class_final[i],
           sex_birth == syn_traits$sex_birth[i])                               # real patients in the same group
  tibble(age_gap = min(abs(same$age_at_enrollment - syn_traits$age_at_enrollment[i])),
         bmi_gap = min(abs(same$bmi - syn_traits$bmi[i])))
})

cat("Synthetic patients with the exact traits of a real patient:", round(100 * exact_match, 1), "%\n")
cat("Age gap to the nearest real patient of the same class and sex (years): median",
    round(median(nearest_gap$age_gap), 2), "; min", round(min(nearest_gap$age_gap), 3), "\n")
cat("BMI gap to the nearest real patient of the same class and sex: median",
    round(median(nearest_gap$bmi_gap), 2), "; min", round(min(nearest_gap$bmi_gap), 3), "\n")
```

## 6. Correlations

```{r correlations}
# Spearman correlations between wearable variables
cor_real <- cor(corsano_real[key_vars], method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
cor_syn  <- cor(corsano_syn[key_vars],  method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
cor_diff <- cor_syn - cor_real

cat("Largest correlation difference (synthetic - real):", round(max(abs(cor_diff)), 2), "\n")
```

```{r correlation plot, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 5}
# heatmap of one correlation matrix
cor_plot <- function(m, title) {
  dimnames(m) <- map(dimnames(m), ~ gsub("hrvAnalysis_|_daily", "", .x))   # short names
  as.data.frame(as.table(m)) %>%                                          # matrix -> long table (Var1, Var2, Freq)
    ggplot(aes(Var1, Var2, fill = Freq)) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(Freq, 2)), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", limits = c(-1, 1)) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Spearman") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

cor_plot(cor_real, "Real") + cor_plot(cor_syn, "Synthetic") + cor_plot(cor_diff, "Synthetic - Real")
```

## 8. Within-patient structure

For each variable: `lme(y ~ weeks, random = ~ weeks | participant_id)` on real and synthetic data (time in weeks so
the slope SD is per week). sd_intercept / sd_slope = how much patients differ in level / in change over time;
sd_resid = day-to-day noise; lag1_cor = correlation of a patient's residuals on consecutive rows.

```{r variance components}
# var components for one variable
var_components <- function(db, var) {
  d <- db %>%
    mutate(y = .data[[var]],
           weeks = Days_since_bio / 7) %>%        # time in weeks
    filter(!is.na(y)) %>%
    arrange(participant_id, Days_since_bio)

  # random intercept + slope model
  f <- tryCatch(lme(y ~ weeks, random = ~ weeks | participant_id, data = d, method = "ML",
                    control = lmeControl(opt = "optim")),
                error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(f)) return(tibble(variable = var))

  sds <- as.numeric(VarCorr(f)[, "StdDev"])   # sd as numeric: intercept, slope, residual

  # residual and the same patient's residual on the previous row
  r <- d %>%
    mutate(e = resid(f)) %>%
    group_by(participant_id) %>%
    mutate(e_prev = lag(e)) %>%
    ungroup()

  tibble(variable = var,
         sd_intercept = sds[1],
         sd_slope = sds[2],
         sd_resid = sds[3],
         lag1_cor = cor(r$e, r$e_prev, use = "complete.obs"))
}

# all variables, real and synthetic
vc_table <- map_dfr(key_vars, function(v) {
  bind_rows(Real = var_components(corsano_real, v),
            Synthetic = var_components(corsano_syn, v),
            .id = "source")
})
print(as.data.frame(vc_table), digits = 3)
```

```{r steroid switches}
# times a patient's steroid status changes between consecutive days
steroid_switches <- both %>%
  arrange(source, participant_id, Days_since_bio) %>%
  filter(!is.na(on_any_steroid)) %>%
  group_by(source, participant_id) %>%
  summarise(n_switch = sum(on_any_steroid != lag(on_any_steroid), na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  summarise(mean_switches = mean(n_switch),
            pct_never_switch = round(100 * mean(n_switch == 0), 1),
            max_switches = max(n_switch),
            .groups = "drop")
print(steroid_switches)
```


## 9. Model transfer

The question that matters: would an analyst reach the same conclusions from the synthetic data?
`Model4WearablesV2_DailyMeans()` from PART 4 is run unchanged on the real and the synthetic data (same call as PART 4).
Each run writes its usual Excel file, plots and GOF plots to its own folder under `Corsano_Models/`.

```{r run PART 4 models, results = "hide", fig.show = "hide"}
# run the PART 4 function on one dataset, in its own folder
run_part4 <- function(d, label) {
  res_dir <- file.path(results.dir, "Corsano_Models", label)
  dir.create(res_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  res <- Model4WearablesV2_DailyMeans(db = d, vars2run = key_vars, time_column = "Days_since_bio",
                                      resp_class = "resp_class_final", covs = covs,
                                      max_days = max_days, results.dir = res_dir)
  graphics.off()                                       # close devices left open if check_model() fails
  res$results %>%
    compact() %>%                                      # drop variables that failed
    set_names(map_chr(., "variable"))
}

real_fits <- run_part4(corsano_real, "Original")
syn_fits  <- run_part4(corsano_syn, paste0("Synthetic_seed_", seed_to_assess))
```

```{r compare helpers}
# share of each CI covered by the other, averaged (1 = identical CIs)
ci_overlap <- function(l1, u1, l2, u2) {
  ov <- pmax(0, pmin(u1, u2) - pmax(l1, l2))
  (ov / (u1 - l1) + ov / (u2 - l2)) / 2
}

# knots of the model BIC picked
best_knots <- function(x) {
  as.integer(gsub("knots", "", x$model_comparison$Model[which.min(x$model_comparison$BIC)]))
}
```

```{r transfer by variable}
# per variable: same knots? same estimated means? same significance calls?
transfer_by_var <- map_dfr(key_vars, function(v) {
  r <- real_fits[[v]]
  s <- syn_fits[[v]]
  if (is.null(r) || is.null(s)) return(tibble(variable = v))

  # bi-weekly estimated means by class
  m <- inner_join(r$results, s$results, by = c("time_var", "resp_class"), suffix = c("_r", "_s"))

  # Non-Responder - Responder contrasts
  b <- inner_join(r$between, s$between, by = c("time_var", "contrast"), suffix = c("_r", "_s"))

  # within-class change from day 0
  w <- m %>% filter(!is.na(p_within_r), !is.na(p_within_s))

  tibble(variable = v,
         knots_real = best_knots(r),
         knots_syn = best_knots(s),
         emmean_ci_overlap = median(ci_overlap(m$lower.CL_r, m$upper.CL_r, m$lower.CL_s, m$upper.CL_s)),
         between_decision_agree = mean((b$p_between_r < 0.05) == (b$p_between_s < 0.05)),
         within_decision_agree = mean((w$p_within_r < 0.05) == (w$p_within_s < 0.05)))
})
print(as.data.frame(transfer_by_var), digits = 3)
```


```{r covariate effects}
# covariate coefficients (age, sex, BMI, steroid), real vs synthetic, per variable
cov_terms <- function(x) {
  tibble(term = names(fixef(x$model)),
         est = unname(fixef(x$model)),
         se = unname(sqrt(diag(vcov(x$model))))) %>%
    filter(!grepl("resp_class|time_var|Intercept", term))   # covariates only
}

covariate_compare <- map_dfr(key_vars, function(v) {
  if (is.null(real_fits[[v]]) || is.null(syn_fits[[v]])) return(tibble())
  inner_join(cov_terms(real_fits[[v]]), cov_terms(syn_fits[[v]]), by = "term", suffix = c("_real", "_syn")) %>%
    mutate(variable = v,
           p_real = 2 * pnorm(-abs(est_real / se_real)),
           p_syn  = 2 * pnorm(-abs(est_syn / se_syn)),
           same_sign = sign(est_real) == sign(est_syn),
           same_decision = (p_real < 0.05) == (p_syn < 0.05),
           ci_overlap = ci_overlap(est_real - 1.96 * se_real, est_real + 1.96 * se_real,
                                   est_syn - 1.96 * se_syn,   est_syn + 1.96 * se_syn))
})
print(as.data.frame(covariate_compare %>% select(variable, term, est_real, est_syn, p_real, p_syn,
                                                 same_sign, same_decision, ci_overlap)), digits = 3)
```

## 10. Overall utility and privacy

S_pMSE: a CART model tries to tell real rows from synthetic rows (synthpop). 1 = as good as chance; under 10 is usually
called good.
Distance to closest record (DCR): for each synthetic patient-day, the distance to the nearest real patient-day
(standardized). Compare with real patient-days' distance to their nearest *other* real patient-day: if synthetic rows
are much closer than that, the generator is copying.

```{r S_pMSE}
utility_vars <- c("Days_since_bio", key_vars, covs, "resp_class_final")

# synthpop needs data.frames with factors
prep <- function(db) {
  as.data.frame(db[utility_vars]) %>%
    mutate(sex_birth = factor(sex_birth),
           on_any_steroid = factor(on_any_steroid),
           resp_class_final = factor(resp_class_final))
}

ug <- utility.gen(prep(corsano_syn), prep(corsano_real), method = "cart", print.flag = FALSE)
cat("S_pMSE:", round(ug$S_pMSE, 2), "\n")
```

```{r distance to closest record}
# patient-days with no missing values: day, age, BMI, wearable variables
dcr_matrix <- function(db) {
  db %>%
    select(Days_since_bio, age_at_enrollment, bmi, all_of(key_vars)) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    as.matrix()
}
real_m <- dcr_matrix(corsano_real)
syn_m  <- dcr_matrix(corsano_syn)

# standardize both with the real means and SDs
centre <- colMeans(real_m)
scl    <- apply(real_m, 2, sd)
real_m <- scale(real_m, centre, scl)
syn_m  <- scale(syn_m, centre, scl)

# distance from each row of 'from' to its nearest row of 'to'
nearest_dist <- function(from, to, same = FALSE) {
  map_dbl(seq_len(nrow(from)), function(i) {
    d <- sqrt(colSums((t(to) - from[i, ])^2))   # distance to every row of 'to'
    if (same) d[i] <- Inf                        # real vs real: skip itself
    min(d)
  })
}

dcr <- bind_rows(tibble(type = "Synthetic to nearest real",  dist = nearest_dist(syn_m, real_m)),
                 tibble(type = "Real to nearest other real", dist = nearest_dist(real_m, real_m, same = TRUE)))

dcr_summary <- dcr %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            pct_exact_copy = round(100 * mean(dist < 1e-8), 2),   # distance 0 = copied row
            q05 = quantile(dist, 0.05),
            median = median(dist),
            .groups = "drop")
print(dcr_summary)
```

```{r dcr plot}
p_dcr <- ggplot(dcr, aes(x = dist, colour = type)) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.8) +
  xlab("Distance to closest record (standardized)") +
  ylab("Density") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank())
p_dcr
```


## 11. Summary

```{r summary}
summary_table <- tribble(
  ~check, ~result, ~good_if,
  "Days per patient (median), real / synthetic",
    paste(day_summary$days_per_patient_median, collapse = " / "), "similar",
  "Largest missing-% difference",
    paste0(round(max(abs(missing_summary$Real - missing_summary$Synthetic)), 1), " points"), "< 5 points",
  "Synthetic patients with exact real traits",
    paste0(round(100 * exact_match, 1), "%"), "0%",
  "Largest Spearman correlation difference",
    as.character(round(max(abs(cor_diff)), 2)), "< 0.10",
  "Variables where BIC picks the same knots",
    paste0(sum(transfer_by_var$knots_real == transfer_by_var$knots_syn, na.rm = TRUE), " of ", length(key_vars)), "all",
  "Estimated means: median CI overlap",
    as.character(round(median(transfer_by_var$emmean_ci_overlap, na.rm = TRUE), 2)), "near 1",
  "Non-Responder vs Responder: same significance call",
    paste0(round(100 * mean(transfer_by_var$between_decision_agree, na.rm = TRUE)), "%"), "high",
  "Within-class change: same significance call",
    paste0(round(100 * mean(transfer_by_var$within_decision_agree, na.rm = TRUE)), "%"), "high",
  "Covariates: same significance call",
    paste0(round(100 * mean(covariate_compare$same_decision)), "%"), "high",
  "S_pMSE",
    as.character(round(ug$S_pMSE, 2)), "< 10",
  "Synthetic patient-days that copy a real one exactly",
    paste0(dcr_summary$pct_exact_copy[dcr_summary$type == "Synthetic to nearest real"], "%"), "0%"
)
knitr::kable(summary_table)

write_csv(summary_table, file.path(results.dir, "PART_2_summary.csv"))
